set: wall_same h60 (67 states; 1 truncated recorded arm < 120 s -> 66 at 120 s)

definitions.entrant: id absent from the t0 modelled set (lane>=0 at t0) with a present lane>=0 row at tick>=1; split new_entry (not in t0 frame at all) vs junction_at_t0 (on lane -1 at t0)
definitions.affected: recorded same-lane leader OR follower at any tick<=h is an entrant (lane -1 rows excluded)
definitions.matched: t0 HDV present in BOTH predicted and recorded frames at t0+h; HDV = recorded is_cav False
definitions.zones: t0 lane==2 -> on_ramp; lane 0/1: s in [0,75.44] merge_zone, s<0 upstream_mainline, s>75.44 downstream_mainline (SECTIONS bounds from src/wms/eval/metrics.py)
definitions.pooled_vs_reported: attribution uses POOLED per-HDV values; the ROUND4_SCORE metric is the median over states of per-state medians (both reported)

wall_pilot_entrant_scan.note: id-set scan only, no rollouts; same zero-entrant property as wall_same
